name: Get your SMS activity aggregated per day
description: Get your SMS activity aggregated per day. Retrieve a day-by-day breakdown of your transactional SMS activity, with each entry containing the date and counts for requests, delivered, hard bounces, soft bounces, blocked, unsubscribed, replied, accepted, rejected, and skipped messages. Filter by date range using `startDate` and `endDate` (both required together, YYYY-MM-DD format), by a number of past `days` (not compatible with date range), or by `tag`. Results are sorted in descending…

startDate.description: **Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report

endDate.description: **Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the report

days.description: Number of days in the past including today (positive integer). **Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'**

sort.title: TransactionalSmsStatisticsReportsGetParametersSort
sort.description: Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed

accepted.description: Number of accepted SMS for the date

blocked.description: Number of blocked contact for the date

date.description: Date for which statistics are retrieved

delivered.description: Number of delivered SMS for the date

hardBounces.description: Number of hardbounces for the date

rejected.description: Number of rejected SMS for the date

replied.description: Number of answered SMS for the date

requests.description: Number of requests for the date

skipped.description: Number of skipped SMS for the date

softBounces.description: Number of softbounces for the date
